slides.headline: ANTHROPIC LOST $42B, WILL SELL YOU SHARES ANYWAY

caption:
Anthropic just disclosed a $42 billion loss in 2025 and is now going public.

The company behind Claude lost $42 billion in 2025. Anthropic projects the world will need $518 billion in AI infrastructure in the coming year alone. Both numbers came out when Anthropic opened its books to let regular investors in, along with a claim that AI will change the global economy more than electricity, industrialization, and the internet combined. $518 billion is more than the entire economy of most countries on Earth, and if you buy into this, you are helping fund it directly. A company that just posted a $42 billion loss is now asking the public for even more.

This is what it costs to build what they believe will be bigger than the internet. AI companies are burning money at a scale most industries never see, and now they want regular investors in the room too.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you where this is actually headed.

Sources: unusual_whales on X

[1] has the same story but loses the identity hook, so it registers as generic startup news instead of a recognizable company making an audacious ask.
